spec.description: Must be open-company/v0. This generation is experimental.

id.description: UUID of the company that wrote this package. Writers include it. Readers still accept packages that omit it. Import does not adopt this id.

name.description: Display name. The spec measures length after trimming whitespace: 1–200. This schema's minLength/maxLength apply to the raw string and do not trim.

description.description: Optional one-line description. If present, non-empty after trimming.
